posts.body:
Dark Matter: Hudokai
is a J-RPG inspired sci-fi adventure crafted with
RPG Maker VX Ace
, blending nostalgic elements from classic RPGs with more modern, action-based combat.
The universe is held together by dark matter—an unseen force that the Cult of Kai seeks to control. After escaping a prison ship, Nova finds himself in the enigmatic "Nexus", where he becomes entangled in a perilous struggle against the cult. As the stakes rise, Nova teams up with the determined vice-warden Lione Burgess and a crew of misfit outlaws to thwart the cult's sinister plans. But time is running out, and Nova’s lost memories might hold the key to the cult’s defeat—or their ultimate victory.
Characters
Nova
Nova - an enigmatic man with a mysterious past he can't quite remember. Some say he committed the worst of all crimes, condemning him to a prison ship. Having escaped, he now looks to right the wrongs of his past by taking down the villainous Cult of Kai.
Lione Burgess
Vice warden for the Galactic Preservation, Lione strives to uphold the law as part of the Galactic Preservation. Despite an uneasy alliance with Nova, she maintains control through her no-nonsense attitude. But she may yet be hiding a difficult past and family ties.
Aliza Legion
With Dissociative Identity Disorder (aka Multiplicity), headstrong Aliza shares her body with Blake and Rizumu. When not reading books, she's using her sharp intelligence to take out enemies with her crossbow. With a limited lifespan, she hunts down the manifestation of her id.
Phoenix Fox
Living in the moment, Phoenix fights for freedom for those who deserve it. Quick witted and wise-cracking, he uses a stolen experimental gauntlet developed by the Cult of Kai. More than anything, he fights in memory of his wasteland friend, Leo.
Maximillion Judge
A foul-mouthed teenager who means well, Maximillion Judge seeks out his father and home world. Home is where the heart is, so he says, and Max has a big heart. He wields Roke's partner's scythe as a 'Deathbringer' - a being tasked to reap those who do wrong.
Varsh
Varsh would like nothing more than to vocalise the thoughts that constantly invade his head, all whilst sitting back and letting everyone else do the manual work. But life has other ideas. Working as a gather of information for the biggest library in existence, Varsh travels to seek the answers of the universe.
Kim Silver
Brought up as the scientific specimen, 001, Kim is an enhanced magical being known as a Gear. Thought to be the last of her race, the Final Gear, she looks at the universe with the wonder of a little girl. But this pure girl's destructive power could be manipulated by unscrupulous villains...
Viktor Len
Leader of the Cult of Kai, Viktor Len was plagued with an illness that threatened to end his life early. Driven by a want to live, he funded the creation of a metal body by renowned scientist, Phyllis. Now born anew, his fear of death drives him to want to live forever. With condensed dark matter from the void, called Hudokai, he might just have what he needs. But there's more to V.Len's desires than just living forever and a love of theatre, especially with the building blocks of the universe in his hands...
Features
Fight the Cult of Kai in a 30+ hour game story
Fly across the three galaxies and land in 12 story-related locations in a fully voice-acted adventure. Restore your memories, meet a diverse cast and hunt down the Cult of Kai across 30+ hours of story.
Equip and level up Hudokai gems
Condensed dark matter made physical, Hudokai gives each of the 6 playable characters magical abilities. Equip the Hudokai in weapons and armour to level them up to even stronger variants!
Fight in active battles using equipped skills
Jump, attack and guard in real-time as you combat enemies across the three galaxies. Equip Hudokai abilities and individual character skills to use combat moves on both the ground and air.
Battle in tactical space fights in your ship
Blast off into space and explore the galaxies for 15+ optional locations, or shift gears to more tactical-based combat as you fight off a plethora of enemy spaceships.
And plenty more!
Synthesise and upgrade your weapons, take on bounties, find concept art, gain achievements, play card games and make narrative choices to impact your alignment and change the ending.
